add.name: Sky_storage_shaft
add.note: Measured aperture of ceiling_default_cracked_1, including its full Euler transform. Narrow sky area on the interior side of the black backdrop, shining through the real opening. Upper end of the six-metre cracked shaft, local y5.98; aperture x[-.359,.145], z[-.898,1.027]. Follows SpotLight_2 brightness and visibility so CollideLights can extinguish the room. No rectangular specular highlight.

add.name: Sky_autopsy_breach
add.note: Measured aperture of ceiling_concave_broken_1, including its full Euler transform. Narrow sky area on the interior side of the black backdrop, shining through the real opening.
